description: This file contains PHP unit tests for the TableOfContents functionality in the Daux documentation generator project. It defines mock classes and multiple test cases verifying the correct generation of Table of Contents in Markdown/HTML content, with special attention to edge cases like duplicate and international headers.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Mock engine class to simulate rendering behavior by returning the 'content' key from data array.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: A test class extending the main Template class to override the getEngine method, returning the mocked Engine instance.

classes.name: TableOfContentsTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case class containing multiple tests to verify the behavior of Table of Contents generation in the CommonMarkConverter within this project.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Sets up and returns a configuration array with a custom template renderer for testing.

methods.name: testNoTOCByDefault
methods.description: Verifies that no Table of Contents is added when auto_toc is not enabled.

methods.name: testShouldAddTOCWhenAutoTOCisOn
methods.description: Checks that a TOC is correctly added when 'auto_toc' is enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: testShouldNotAddTOCWhenAutoTOCisOnAndTOCisPresent
methods.description: Ensures that no duplicate TOC is added if a '[TOC]' token is present in the source.

methods.name: testTOCToken
methods.description: Verifies that the '[TOC]' token properly generates a table of contents.

methods.name: testUnicodeTOC
methods.description: Tests that headers with Unicode characters are correctly processed into the TOC.

methods.name: testDuplicatedTOC
methods.description: Checks the behavior when multiple headers with the same text are present, ensuring unique IDs are generated.

methods.name: testEscapedTOC
methods.description: Verifies that headers with special characters like colons are properly converted into IDs.

methods.name: testQuotesWorkCorrectly
methods.description: Ensures that headers containing quotes are correctly processed, with a note that this test runs under PHP < 8.1 due to syntax.
